name: AccessDossier Care
author: AccessDossier

sections.description:
AccessDossier Care helps web agencies look after their clients’ WordPress sites: uptime, SSL and domain warnings, update warnings, and white-label client reports and status pages.

This free connector lets Care see what it needs to warn you before something breaks:

  • WordPress, PHP and database versions, and whether the site is a multisite network
  • Installed plugins and themes (active and inactive), their versions, and which updates are waiting

It is read-only. It never installs, updates, deletes or changes anything. It never sees users, passwords, posts, orders or form entries, and it never asks for a password.

Uptime, SSL and domain checks work without this plugin. The connector adds the inside view: versions and waiting updates.

External services

This plugin is a connector for AccessDossier Care (https://accessdossier.com/), a service run by ReinstateIQ LLC.

The plugin never sends anything on its own. After you paste a connection key, AccessDossier Care requests this site’s status from a REST route the plugin adds (/wp-json/accessdossier-care/v1/status). Only requests signed with your key are answered.

What is shared, and only on those signed requests: the site address; the WordPress, PHP and database versions; whether the site is a multisite network; the names, versions, active or inactive state and available updates of installed plugins and themes; and the connector version.

  • Terms of service: https://accessdossier.com/terms
  • Privacy policy: https://accessdossier.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. In AccessDossier Care, open the site and copy its connection key.
  3. In WordPress, go to Settings > AccessDossier Care, paste the key and click Connect.

To stop sharing, click Disconnect. Deactivating the plugin also stops sharing, but the key stays saved, so sharing resumes if you activate it again. Deleting the plugin deletes the saved key.

Use HTTPS on the site, so the status answers travel encrypted.
sections.faq:
Can this plugin change my site?

No. It only reads versions and update information that WordPress already keeps. It has no code that installs, updates or edits anything.

What does it need from me?

A connection key from AccessDossier Care. No passwords and no user accounts.

How do I stop it?

Click Disconnect on its settings page. Deactivating also stops it until you activate it again.
